record.label: Expected round bounds for large domains
record.statement: For each fixed $(m,k)$, the authors certify a rational $R(m,k)$ such that $\overline{D}_{n,m,k}\le R(m,k)D_{\mathrm{std}}(2^n,m,k)$ for all sufficiently large $n$. The average $\overline{D}_{n,m,k}$ is uniform over marked sets of size $k$.
record.boundary: The correctness theorems apply to each admissible marked set separately. Both cost statements take the uniform average of bounds on the expected number of rounds. In the Find-Any proof, the same upper bound applies to each marked set at a given sufficiently large $n$. Appendix E.1 separately explains how uniformly permuting indices at zero query cost gives a randomized circuit whose expected cost on any fixed marked set equals the original circuit's average.
